purpose: Sub-job of j006 (value-guided BC-mixing screen: AWM, AFM) on hopper-kinematic-legjnt-medium. Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop) before submission.

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21/j004/j005 metric)
rule.strong_control: per task, the group among T, BC, BCMIX with the highest Last5 mean over seeds 3106-3110
rule.screen_effective: candidate minus strong control, paired by seed: mean > 0 and mean > 1 * paired SE
rule.supported: screen-effective on at least 2 of the 3 tasks (j006a/b/c combined) -> a confirmation job with 5 never-used seeds per task on those tasks
rule.rejected: paired mean difference <= 0 on at least 2 of the 3 tasks
rule.descriptive: 2 * SE criterion, candidate minus BCMIX / BC / T, AFM vs AWM, guidance statistics (source weight share, kept fraction, advantages), episode lengths
rule.note: Rules are fixed before results; not changed after results are seen. The verdict is made only after all three sub-jobs finish; if any sub-job fails, no verdict.

candidate_settings.critic: IQL on target rows only, identical updates to group T (expectile 0.7, gamma 0.99, Polyak 0.005, lr 3e-4, batch 64)
candidate_settings.actor: fresh iql_unc.Policy, Adam 3e-4, cosine over 200000 steps, 64 target + 64 source rows (as BCMIX)
candidate_settings.advantage: A = min target-Q(s,a) - V(s), no gradient
candidate_settings.AWM: u = min(exp(3*A),100); w = u/mean(u) over the 128 rows; loss = 2*mean(w*mse)
candidate_settings.AFM: target rows weight 1; source rows weight 1 if A>0 else 0; loss = mean_target(mse) + sum_source(keep*mse)/64
candidate_settings.schedule: 100000 critic-only warm-up steps, then 200000 steps each with one critic step and one actor step; evaluation every 5000 actor steps
